I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from #north-team itself, where Marcus is a member. On Aug 20, 2025, Dana posted that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on the morning shift. The same trailer was being logged twice, once from the kiosk check-in and once when dispatch added it by hand.

A contact is an operational fact, so sharing it with the account team is fine. I didn't use anything from Dana's direct message with me.
